proposal: Trees are objects from the forest seed: x, height and a crown. A few reach the emergent layer.
Shrubs are one continuous band whose fullness follows Density, not individual objects.
Extra high-frequency loss per metre, only for the part of a path that passes through crowns or shrubs.
The Designer flags a species that falls below hearing in the chosen medium.
Option to narrow stereo width in liquids, since human ears hear direction badly under water. Default off.
Reverb is on by default.
Path modes: Still, Walk, Wander, Climb, Follow (species or one individual), with a Speed. Always draggable.
Equal-power pan from horizontal offset relative to distance (straight above = centre). Above is slightly brighter.
Individuals fade in and out over the last 2 m inside the box edges.
Every species number is a min-max range rolled per call; min = max locks it.
Unit, call (1-32 units with gaps), rest. Controls: Units per call, Unit length, Gap, Rest, Evolve.
Signature amount (how often) and Variation (how much it changes).
A curve across the seven layers, drawn on the Species page.
Emergent, Canopy, Subcanopy, Understorey, Shrubs, Ground, Never. Calls in flight and perched. In water, perch = kelp or seabed.
Even, Random or Clumped, plus Spacing (territory size).
How often an individual or its group moves, and how far. Climbers hop between touching crowns, or climb down and walk.
A copy maps the caller's per-unit positions (0-1 in the caller's ranges) into the copier's ranges.
Keep the simple same-voice Timbre match in the prototype; cross-engine matching later.
Lower accuracy adds errors in pitch steps, timing and unit count, and may drop or add units.
Each individual remembers the last few calls it heard, from any species including its own.
Harmonise prefers consonant intervals: scale steps in key, simple ratios when Free.
An individual reacts only if the arriving level is above its species' Hearing (dB SPL).
Only call events travel between animals, never audio; a spatial grid limits who each call reaches.
Everything computed in dB SPL at the listener first.
Fixed (one honest gain) or Adapting (slowly rides the level within a set range).
Starting gain from the expected total power of all species, so play never starts with a blast.
Per-species limiter, then a final limiter at -1 dBFS, idle in normal use.
No hard limit in the files; colours generated around the colour wheel; list scrolls; tested with 64.
Target ceiling of 20,000 individuals per forest, to confirm by benchmark.
A voice budget, quietest at the listener culled first; batch 01 measures it on your Mac.
Export uses a Render threads setting, default all cores.
Pages in plain HTML/CSS/JS, no framework.
Versioned .kanopy-species.json and .kanopy-forest.json; a forest file contains its species.
48 kHz, 24-bit WAV with seed and settings written into the file.
